decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans Proposed hand car wash facilities, Location Plan,   Design & Access Statement submitted 27/10/2011  therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The use hereby permitted for the car wash purposes shall not be carried on outside the following times 08.00-19.00 Monday to Saturday and 09.00-18.00 Sunday & Bank Holidays.

Condition : 4 - No development shall take place until there has been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority a plan indicating the positions, design, materials and type of boundary treatment to be erected. The boundary treatment should be specifically designed to improve screening to adjacent properties. The boundary treatment shall be completed before the use hereby permitted is commenced. Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 5 - No development shall take place until details of a drainage scheme, indicating how surface water will be captured and intercepted prior to connection to the sewer network, have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. These details shall be carried out as approved prior to the commencement of development.

Condition : 6 - The use of the site for car washing shall only be undertaken using the chemicals and cleaning equipment specified in the Design & Access Statement received 27/10/2011, which shall be maintained and kept in good working order.  No other chemicals or cleaning equipment shall be used without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 7 - The rating level of noise emitted from the car washing operations at the site, shall not exceed the existing background noise level. The noise levels shall be determined at the nearest noise sensitive locations. The measurements shall be made according to BS4142:1997.
description: Change of use from A1 to a car wash, Sui Generis
